pressure.tip: The middle of the last three minutes of readings, not the latest one. Left alone the sensor wanders about ±0.04 hPa from one sample to the next, and at these timescales that is the sensor rather than the weather — pressure moves over hours.

energy.title: Energy status
energy.activeConsumptionTip: Measured while the node is awake, which is ~3.6% of each cycle. It isn't the average consumption: duty-cycle corrected it's about 8 mW.

charging.label: Charging
charging.detail: The panel is covering the system's consumption.

surplus.label: Battery full · Solar surplus
surplus.detail: The pack is topped off and the panel is producing more than the station can spend.

discharging.label: Discharging
discharging.detail: No generation available — not enough sunlight. The system is running on the battery.

deficit.label: Deficit
deficit.detail: Solar generation isn't covering the system's current energy consumption.

unknown.label: Measuring…
unknown.detail: About an hour of data is needed to determine the trend.

trend.tip: How fast the air is warming or cooling, measured over the last hour. Under ±1 °C/h counts as steady, over ±3 °C/h as fast.
trend.unknownTip: Not enough samples yet. The window fills about half an hour after the backend restarts, and then the trend appears on its own.

detail.noData: Nothing recorded in this window yet.
detail.spanNote: high to low over the window
detail.profileIntro: Each local hour averaged across the window, with the shaded band showing how far that hour has ranged.
detail.profileNeedsRange: Pick 3 d or more to see this: over a shorter window each hour has a single reading, so the average would just be the series again.

humidity.wetNote: of the window at {{threshold}} % or above

dew.pairTitle: The air and its dew point
dew.pairIntro: The band between the two lines is how far the air is from saturating. Where they meet, dew forms; below 0 °C it is frost instead.
dew.nearNote: of the window at {{margin}} °C or less
dew.frostNote: of the window: frost rather than dew

margin.near: Margin {{margin}} °C — the air is close to saturating
margin.damp: Margin {{margin}} °C — damp air, but not saturating
margin.dry: Margin {{margin}} °C — the air is far from saturating
